title: Selecting Shots for Demographic Fairness in Few-Shot Learning with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing differences in True Positive Rate (recall parity) using the 1-GAP metric for occupation classification models evaluated on biographies written about men versus women (Bias in Bios dataset).

Comparing differences in True Positive Rate (recall parity) using the 1-GAP metric for sentiment classification across African-American English (AAE) and Standard American English (SAE) dialects, and for toxicity classification across different racial target groups (Twitter Sentiment and HateXplain datasets).
